headline: Saga Tekkohsho Co., Ltd. Ransomware Breach Under Investigation
body: Following a significant ransomware attack, Saga Tekkohsho Co., Ltd. is conducting a thorough investigation to assess the full extent of the data breach. The company has engaged external cybersecurity experts to assist in the investigation. Authorities have been informed as part of the company's response to the incident. No downstream impact has been reported at this time.
